actualCause: The Client process was open in Windows session 1, distinct from the elevated installer session. Restart Manager reported Session Mismatch. Inno could not replace flutter_secure_storage_windows_plugin.dll (DeleteFile error 5), rolled back the application payload, and returned exit 5.
postFailure: VentioPostgres was running. The installed older maintenance helper resumed VentioHost but left host-payload-previous.manifest.json. Read-only verification showed this marker was byte-identical to the installed payload manifest, no policy snapshot or schema request existed, and Recovery Authority witness pending was false. The broker's supported resume operation returned 0 and both services are now running.
correctiveSource: 474c3a4 adds an elevated native all-session Client process guard before service stop and installer replacement, plus exact-identity retirement of stale manifest markers only when both services are running and no policy/schema/witness work is pending.
